curatedMovie.curiosityHook: With investigators discovering remnants of the first flight, can they construct a second balloon before the net closes around them?
curatedMovie.description: After a homemade hot air balloon crashes near the border, two East German families must secretly build another craft from scratch while the Stasi aggressively traces evidence of their initial escape attempt.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A fast, nerve-wracking historical thriller packed with heavy emotional stakes and mounting state surveillance.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: The homemade-balloon premise gives this historical thriller a propulsive, high-pressure setup built around planning under surveillance.
